title: Origin story: Susanoo
description: Susanoo was born from Izanagi's nose, given the sea to rule, but wept for his dead mother until his beard grew long. Banished for his grief, he rampaged through heaven — then redeemed himself by slaying the eight-headed serpent Yamata no Orochi and presenting its tail-sword to Amaterasu.
